requiredScope: The complete required language and role scope remains in force.

Mutation/Insert/WriteSlot.role: A writable native position in the single selected INSERT relation.
Mutation/Insert/WriteSlot.structure: A nonnegative physical slot, its immutable int4 or text kind, and the single admitted occurrence zero.
Mutation/Insert/WriteSlot.conditions: The owning destination checks the exact native kind at its physical position and rejects repeated write positions.
Mutation/Insert/WriteSlot.meaning: Identifies the corresponding target for each row of supplied values.
Mutation/Insert/WriteSlot.sql: Emit the owning relation's physical field name in the checked write order.

Mutation/Insert/Destination.role: The absolute writable relation and checked ordered native targets.
Mutation/Insert/Destination.structure: One TableSource and a detached nonempty ordered list of WriteSlot values.
Mutation/Insert/Destination.conditions: Every position exists, with its declared native kind and a distinct coordinate. A matching external declaration supplies writable, ordinary columns.
Mutation/Insert/Destination.meaning: Match each supplied cell to exactly one native target field. Omitted fields retain their declared database behavior.
Mutation/Insert/Destination.sql: Render the canonical table and ordered quoted field names.

Mutation/InsertCell.role: One explicit supplied native value in a literal VALUES row.
Mutation/InsertCell.structure: A signed int4 literal, a UTF-8 native text literal or explicit SQL NULL.
Mutation/InsertCell.conditions: The owning INSERT aligns it with the written native kind. NULL can inhabit either supported native kind.
Mutation/InsertCell.meaning: Store exactly the explicit scalar, preserving the difference between an empty string, other text and SQL NULL.
Mutation/InsertCell.sql: Write exact native decimal or UTF-8 text, or the SQL NULL keyword.

externalInterpretation: Use the same ordinary physical table with native int4 and text positions, distinct nullable values and default declarations for omitted fields.
observations: Preserve each written position and value independently of physical column order.
Distinguish explicit NULL, empty text, quotes, backslashes, multiline text and non-ASCII UTF-8.
Observe the affected count, returned native result labels and kinds, multiplicity, physical row state and restoration.
An omitted text field uses its database default. An explicitly supplied NULL remains NULL.

finite.completeness: Recover native target order, first text cell payload class and ordered row arity from the observed public value.

exploration.requiredForms: Vary target order and omissions, row count, repeated rows, nullable typed cells, exact string bytes, return labels and positions.

analysis: Write one bare text value and observe the omitted text default.
Insert mixed typed columns written in the opposite physical order, with repeated rows.
Preserve qualified text literals, SQL NULL and distinct output labels.
Return both text and integer columns through a target wildcard.
negative: An explicit text cell writes a native int4 position.
An explicit int4 cell writes a native text position.
A write position promises a kind different from its actual declaration.
A write position lies outside the target occurrence.
A VALUES row is narrower than its destination.
faults: Reverse the two cells of a same-kind row without changing the write layout.
Render an empty text cell as SQL NULL.
Drop the second repeated row from the emitted insert.

evidence.P01: Measure the actual writable native coordinates and same-kind explicit scalar cells.
evidence.P02: Check local roles, owned write positions, each row's width and native correspondence.
evidence.P03: Retain only the absolute relation, resolved positions, typed cells and returned fields.
evidence.P04: Compose ordered rows and fields through the checked write layout.
evidence.P05: Audit immutable scalar operands and detached ordered lists.
evidence.P06: Observe equivalent inserted rows, native metadata and physical effects under both releases.
evidence.Q01: Audit each checked boundary and reject the controlled mismatches.
evidence.Q02: Recover each finite combination and require all exploratory and analyzed positives.
evidence.Q03: Independently map cells by position and apply external defaults to omitted fields.
evidence.Q04: Compare real database effects and expose the selected write and rendering faults.
evidence.Q05: Capture exact installed runtime bytes, package roles and independent observation evidence.

open: Text-valued INSERT SELECT, explicit DEFAULT cells, conflicts and other native kinds retain their own obligations.
trust: The matching declared physical target and native default behavior
